content:
Live Dosa Catering

London | Wembley | Tooting

Why Choose Our Live Dosa Station Catering?

Bring the joy of authentic South Indian flavors to your special occasions with Skaryabhavan’s Live Dosa Catering for homes and events. Our expert dosa chefs set up a dosa live station right at your venue, serving hot, crispy dosas along with freshly prepared chutneys and sambar. Whether it’s a cozy family gathering, birthday celebration, or a house party, your guests can enjoy restaurant-style dosas without leaving the comfort of your home.

Make your celebration truly unforgettable with Skaryabhavan’s Live Masala Dosa Party experience — every dosa is made fresh, customized to your guests’ taste, and served with love. We take pride in offering 100% pure vegetarian catering, ensuring top-quality hygiene, authentic flavors, and complete satisfaction in every bite.

From weddings and housewarming events to corporate gatherings, Skaryabhavan’s Live Dosa Station Catering adds a fun, interactive, and delicious highlight that your guests will always remember.

Enquire Now

Live Dosa Catering Menu

Authentic South Indian cuisine, prepared fresh at your celebration

 

Monday to Friday

£14.00

(Minimum 35 Persons)

 

Sat, Sun & Bank Holiday

£15.00

(Minimum 40 Persons )

  Book Now

★ All Add-ons Are Charged Separately Per Person ★

★ 2 Hours Pure Vibes ★

Menu Items

  • Sweet (Pongal / Payasam / Kesari)
  • Plain Dosa (LIVE)
  • Masala Dosa (LIVE)
  • Onion Dosa (LIVE)
  • Ghee Dosa (LIVE)
  • Podi Dosa (LIVE)
  • Millet Dosa
  • Onion Chilli Uthappam (LIVE)
  • Medhu Vada (LIVE)

Menu Items

  • Paya Idly
  • Veg Biryani
  • Vada Curry
  • Coconut Chutney
  • Tomato Chutney
  • Coriander Chutney
  • Sambar
  • Tea / Coffee

Add-ons Items

  • Poori Bhaji Live £3.00
  • Chole Batura Live £3.00
  • Chilli Panneer £2.00
  • Pani Puri £2.00
  • Dahi Puri £2.00
  • Gulab Jamun £1.00 (1 pc)
  • Rasmalai £2.00 per pcs
  • Paan £1.00 per pcs
  • Pineapple Kesari £1.00 per person
Book Now

Faqs

Do you bring all the cooking equipment for live dosa catering?

We bring all the required equipment including cooker, gas, and other essentials.

Do you provide plates, spoons, and napkins?

Yes, we provide biodegradable disposable plates, spoons, forks, and napkins unless you specify otherwise.

How are the charges calculated for dosa catering?

We will go ahead with the plate count, not the head count. Please note only plate for one person

Is there a transportation fee for catering services?

Yes, transportation is charged at £2 per mile to and from the destination.

How long do you serve food at an event?

We serve food for 2 hours at your premises, with an additional 30 minutes required for setup. Extra time beyond this will be charged at £60 per hour.

What do customers need to provide for the setup?

Not required we will bring our own tables

What is the payment policy for booking live dosa catering?

30% token of advance to cofirm the event balance can we paid end of the day

Can I customize the menu with additional items?

Yes you can add with any extra cost

Do you provide tents or gazebos for outdoor catering?

No, we do not provide tents or gazebos.

Do your dishes contain allergens such as nuts or sesame?

At Arya Bhavan Restaurant, our food is prepared in a kitchen where nuts, sesame, and other allergenic ingredients are used, and despite our care, we cannot guarantee that any dish is completely free from allergen traces. Therefore, our menu may not be suitable for individuals with severe food allergies.
